title: A member looks from a typed place, and home stays the default

criteria.text: The place control on Explore takes a typed town, county or market with suggestions; shows the home town by default
criteria.note: The place control is `AreaPicker` (a metro list and a neighbourhood search), plain text with a pin since #956; no typed town, county or market, no suggestions over the place tree [V src/components/explore/AreaPicker.tsx]. #932's `explore_vantage` starts the rings from the member's home town but names it only as 'you' and offers no control [V]. Open #698, deferred.

criteria.text: Choosing a place sets the vantage for the session and is taken as the area type it is; the rings rebuild there
criteria.note: No vantage model in the repo; today `?metro=`, `?area=` and a metro cookie (#479) [V]. #932's rings rebuild only from the home town or the market's principal city, never from a chosen place [V]. Open #698.

criteria.text: The vantage is session-only: never written to the member, never logged, never from IP or GPS; a shared link reopens it
criteria.note: Not built; today the metro is a cookie and `default_metro_id` on the member, and the area pick is saved as the member's default (#479) [V]. `?reach=` already travels in the link (#932). A guard is in #698's checklist. Open #698.

criteria.text: A vantage in a waiting market shows its cached waiting count and the tell-me control, and no Pages; another open market shows in full
criteria.note: The waitlist count and tell-me panel exist for a metro (`MetroNotCoveredPanel`, F076) but no vantage reaches them, and the cached count still throws for the signed-out join (#686) [V]. Open #699.

criteria.text: A visitor with no location is prompted to enter a location or choose a market, with an arrow to the market selector; nothing is picked
criteria.note: Not built: `resolveFeedMetro` still picks Sacramento for a visitor, and #932 starts a signed-out visitor's rings from the market's principal city [V]. Ruled 2026-10-12 (F105 Rulings). Prompt copy goes to the PM before production; #588 is needs-pm and #699 carries the open question. Open #699, #588.
